rule.name: Azure AD Suspicious Device Registration
rule.description:
The following analytic detects suspicious Azure Active Directory device registrations by monitoring "Register device" audit events for device names matching specific DESKTOP patterns or the user agent "Dsreg/10.0 (Windows 10.0.19041.928)".
This user agent may indicate device registration activity through ROADtools, an offensive security framework targeting EntraID deployments.
Device registration can support persistence or provide a device identity that can be used to access internal resources.
If confirmed malicious, an attacker could use the registered device to maintain access or facilitate further compromise of the environment.
rule.query:
`azure_monitor_aad` operationName="Register device" (
    properties.targetResources{}.displayName IN (
        "*-PC",
        "DESKTOP-*",
        "EC2AMAZ-*",
        "LAPTOP-*",
        "MININT-*",
        "MSEDGEWIN10",
        "WIN-*"
    )
    OR
    properties.userAgent="Dsreg/*"
)
| rename properties.targetResources{}.displayName as dvc, properties.userAgent as user_agent
| fillnull
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime
              max(_time) as lastTime
              values(result) as result
              values(user_agent) as user_agent

  by tenantId user src dvc signature vendor_account vendor_product

| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `azure_ad_suspicious_device_registration_filter`
false_positives: Users may register devices with names that match the suspicious patterns. Filter as needed.
